name: NY-14
label: Safe D

key_factors: Ocasio-Cortez's massive financial advantage ($32.6M raised vs $0.3M)
Prediction markets price her at ~96% to win
model.rationale: The +19 Democratic lean, Ocasio-Cortez's incumbency, and a roughly 95-to-1 fundraising advantage make a Republican upset implausible; markets price her win probability near 96%. No polls or expert ratings contradict the fundamentals, so the forecast stays at a wide Democratic margin.
model.watch: A surprise red-wave national environment or an unexpectedly well-funded challenger could narrow the margin, though not enough to threaten the seat.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez seeks reelection in a New York City district that leans Democratic by about 19 points. She is a high-profile incumbent with a dominant war chest, having raised over $32 million and holding nearly $16 million on hand, while Republican Diamant Hysenaj has raised only about $343,000 with minimal cash remaining. No outside groups are spending against her.

No public general-election polls or expert ratings are available for this race, but prediction markets price her at roughly a 96 percent chance of winning. With the fundamentals, money, and incumbency all pointing the same direction, the district is rated Safe Democratic, with the main question being the size of the margin rather than the outcome.
